brownie.prep: Grease your pan ({pan}) and line it with parchment paper, leaving an overhang to lift the brownies out.
brownie.cook: Spread the batter evenly in the pan. Bake at {temp} for {time}, until the edges are set and the center is just firm.
brownie.check: A toothpick inserted into the center should come out with a few moist crumbs, not wet batter. Do not overbake - brownies firm up as they cool.
notes: Thicker brownies (smaller pan) need longer and thinner ones (larger pan) bake faster - start checking early.
Cool completely before cutting for clean squares.

recipes.name: Classic Brownies
recipes.description: Chewy, fudgy cocoa brownies with a shiny, crackly top.

less.note: Sugar gives brownies their chewy, crackly top and moist, fudgy center, so the safe reduction is about 20%.
expectedChanges: Top may be less shiny and crackly
Slightly more cake-like and less fudgy

steps.title: Mix Butter, Sugar and Cocoa
steps.text: In a large bowl, stir the melted butter, sugar and cocoa powder until smooth.

steps.title: Add Eggs and Vanilla
steps.text: Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla, and stir for about a minute until glossy.

steps.title: Add Flour
steps.text: Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt until just combined. Do not overmix.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool completely in the pan, then lift out and cut into squares.

tips: For a crackly top, stir the batter well after adding the eggs.
Cool the brownies completely before cutting - a knife dipped in hot water makes clean edges.
Chill them for 30 minutes for neater squares.

panOptions.text: two 9×13 in / 23×33 cm pans, or one 13×18 in / 33×46 cm half-sheet pan
several 9×13 in / 23×33 cm pans - bake them one or two at a time

recipes.name: Chocolate Brownies
recipes.description: Extra-fudgy brownies made with melted chocolate chips and cocoa.

less.note: The chocolate chips add sweetness too, but sugar gives the fudgy texture, so the reduction is about 20%.
expectedChanges: Slightly deeper, less sweet chocolate flavor
Top may be less shiny and crackly

steps.title: Melt the Chocolate
steps.text: Melt the butter and chocolate chips together in a saucepan over low heat (or in the microwave in short bursts), stirring until smooth. Let it cool for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add Sugar, Eggs and Vanilla
steps.text: Whisk the sugar into the chocolate mixture, then beat in the eggs one at a time and the vanilla until glossy.

steps.title: Add Flour and Cocoa
steps.text: Stir in the flour, cocoa powder and salt until just combined. Do not overmix.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool completely in the pan, then lift out and cut into squares.

tips: Let the melted chocolate cool slightly before adding the eggs so they do not scramble.
These are fudgy - a few moist crumbs on the toothpick are perfect.
Store in the fridge for an even denser, fudgier texture.

recipes.name: Walnut Brownies
recipes.description: Classic fudgy brownies with crunchy walnuts.

less.note: Sugar gives brownies their chewy, crackly top and moist, fudgy center, so the safe reduction is about 20%.
expectedChanges: Top may be less shiny and crackly
Slightly more cake-like and less fudgy

steps.title: Mix Butter, Sugar and Cocoa
steps.text: In a large bowl, stir the melted butter, sugar and cocoa powder until smooth.

steps.title: Add Eggs and Vanilla
steps.text: Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla, and stir for about a minute until glossy.

steps.title: Add Flour
steps.text: Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt until just combined. Do not overmix.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool completely in the pan, then lift out and cut into squares.

tips: Toast the walnuts for 5 minutes first for a deeper flavor.
Save a handful of walnuts to press on top of the batter before baking.
Chop the nuts coarsely so every square has crunch.
